dashboard.description: Engine coolant temperature.
dashboard.label: Coolant

dashboard.description: Fuel temperature from the fuel tank temperature sensor.
dashboard.label: Fuel temperature

dashboard.description: Selected learned trim cell of bank 2, in percent. The publisher combines this cell with the running adjustment minus 100 percent before its conditional clamps and neutralization.
dashboard.label: LTFT learned bank 2

dashboard.description: Running adjustment of the bank 2 long-term trim, in percent.
dashboard.label: LTFT adjustment bank 2

dashboard.description: Short-term fuel trim of bank 1: the fast closed-loop correction from the A/F sensor, in percent. A positive value adds fuel.
dashboard.label: STFT bank 1

dashboard.description: Short-term fuel trim of bank 2: the fast closed-loop correction from the A/F sensor, in percent. A positive value adds fuel.
dashboard.label: STFT bank 2

dashboard.description: Duty of the bank 1 intake valve timing solenoid, in percent of its PWM period; the output that moves the camshaft. A larger duty advances the camshaft.
dashboard.label: CVTC duty B1

dashboard.description: Duty of the bank 2 intake valve timing solenoid, in percent of its PWM period; the output that moves the camshaft. A larger duty advances the camshaft.
dashboard.label: CVTC duty B2

dashboard.description: Long-term fuel trim of bank 1 as diagnostics report it: the learned cell of the operating region plus the running adjustment, in percent. A positive value adds fuel.
dashboard.label: LTFT bank 1

dashboard.description: Long-term fuel trim of bank 2 as diagnostics report it: the learned cell of the operating region plus the running adjustment, in percent. A positive value adds fuel.
dashboard.label: LTFT bank 2

fields.name: active_map_index
fields.scale: raw + 1; 0 through 4 select Maps 1 through 5, and any other value selects Map 1

dashboard.description: A byte curve-result coordinate derived from opening-area-domain counts divided by engine speed, used by the identified map consumer. Displayed in stored counts. Catalog QH0 Flow Quantity at x*0.390625 percent. The expression equals 100*x/256 numerically, but the physical quantity and reference are not established. The candidate percentage describes the retained catalog coordinate presentation, not a physical measurement or a universal target-layout consumer identity.
dashboard.label: Fuel-compensation column count

dashboard.description: Telemetry protocol version that the ECU reports in the health context. Values are converted only when it matches the bundled schema.
dashboard.label: Protocol version

dashboard.description: CRC16 of the wire layout that the ECU reports in the health context. Values are converted only when it equals the CRC of the bundled profile, because another layout carries other quantities in the same slots.
dashboard.label: Profile CRC16

dashboard.description: Smallest knock margin of evaluator channel 1 since the previous capture of its context: the knock threshold minus the knock metric, in evaluator counts without a physical unit. A positive value is headroom below the threshold, and a negative value is an evaluation that the ECU counts as knock. The channel number is the cylinder number of the event that opens the knock window.
dashboard.label: Knock margin ch 1

fields.name: knock_margin_min_ch1_raw
fields.scale: threshold minus metric in evaluator units, minimum since the previous capture of this context; 32767 without an evaluation or for a margin of 32767 or more

dashboard.description: Smallest knock margin of evaluator channel 2 since the previous capture of its context: the knock threshold minus the knock metric, in evaluator counts without a physical unit. A positive value is headroom below the threshold, and a negative value is an evaluation that the ECU counts as knock. The channel number is the cylinder number of the event that opens the knock window.
dashboard.label: Knock margin ch 2

fields.name: knock_margin_min_ch2_raw
fields.scale: threshold minus metric in evaluator units, minimum since the previous capture of this context; 32767 without an evaluation or for a margin of 32767 or more

dashboard.description: Smallest knock margin of evaluator channel 3 since the previous capture of its context: the knock threshold minus the knock metric, in evaluator counts without a physical unit. A positive value is headroom below the threshold, and a negative value is an evaluation that the ECU counts as knock. The channel number is the cylinder number of the event that opens the knock window. The stock threshold row of this channel holds 0xFFFF, so it reads -- unless the metric exceeds 32768.
dashboard.label: Knock margin ch 3

fields.name: knock_margin_min_ch3_raw
fields.scale: threshold minus metric in evaluator units, minimum since the previous capture of this context; 32767 without an evaluation or for a margin of 32767 or more

dashboard.description: Reason code of the Rolling Launch runtime. In IDLE it names the first activation gate that fails, such as MAP DISABLED on a map without Rolling Launch or BUTTON INVALID while CANCEL is not held. ACTIVE reads NONE, and COOLDOWN keeps the reason that ended the run, such as BUTTON RELEASED, TIMEOUT, or MAP REQUEST.
dashboard.label: Rolling Launch reason

fields.name: rolling_launch_abort_reason
fields.scale: enumeration: 0 NONE, 1 CONFIG_INVALID, 2 MAP_INDEX_INVALID, 3 MAP_DISABLED, 4 SELECTOR_BUSY, 5 FEEDBACK_BUSY, 6 MAIN_PRESSED, 7 BUTTON_RELEASED, 8 BUTTON_INVALID, 9 SPEED_LOW, 10 RPM_LOW, 11 PEDAL_LOW, 12 COOLANT_OUTSIDE, 13 RESERVED_13, 14 TIMEOUT, 15 MAP_REQUEST, 16 STATE_CORRUPT, 17 MAP_CHANGED, 18 MODE_CHANGED

dashboard.description: Battery voltage at the ECU supply.
dashboard.label: Battery voltage

dashboard.description: Selected learned trim cell of bank 1, in percent. The publisher combines this cell with the running adjustment minus 100 percent before its conditional clamps and neutralization.
dashboard.label: LTFT learned bank 1

dashboard.description: Running adjustment of the bank 1 long-term trim, in percent.
dashboard.label: LTFT adjustment bank 1

dashboard.description: Intake air temperature.
dashboard.label: Intake air

dashboard.description: Engine oil temperature.
dashboard.label: Oil temperature

dashboard.description: Commanded fuel multiplier against the stoichiometric base schedule. 1.0000 is the closed-loop stoichiometric target, and a larger value commands enrichment: the target map supplies 1.00..1.16. The commanded lambda is 1 / factor.
dashboard.label: A/F state factor

dashboard.description: End of injection in crank degrees after intake TDC of the injected cylinder. A firmware coordinate from the injection-end tables, not a measured injector event.
dashboard.label: End of injection after intake TDC

dashboard.description: Front A/F sensor signal of bank 1 in volts, the item the factory data monitor calls A/F SEN1: 2.20 V is the sensor reference, and lower is richer. It is not converted to AFR: the ECU curve from voltage to lambda is not identified, and under sustained enrichment the reading moves lean.
dashboard.label: Front A/F sensor B1

dashboard.description: Front A/F sensor signal of bank 2 in volts, the item the factory data monitor calls A/F SEN1: 2.20 V is the sensor reference, and lower is richer. It is not converted to AFR: the ECU curve from voltage to lambda is not identified, and under sustained enrichment the reading moves lean.
dashboard.label: Front A/F sensor B2

dashboard.description: A/F adjustment of bank 1: the signed correction that the ECU integrates from the difference between the target mixture and the A/F sensor 1 mixture, bounded to -500..500 counts. The candidate factor 0.002 maps the factory running range to -0.33..0.33. Every recording so far reads 0.
dashboard.label: A/F adjustment B1

dashboard.description: Throttle position sensor 2 of the bank 1 throttle body in volts, the second track that the ECU checks against sensor 1; it rises with opening.
dashboard.label: Secondary TPS B1

dashboard.description: Throttle position sensor 2 of the bank 2 throttle body in volts, the second track that the ECU checks against sensor 1; it rises with opening.
dashboard.label: Secondary TPS B2

dashboard.description: A/F adjustment of bank 2: the signed correction that the ECU integrates from the difference between the target mixture and the A/F sensor 1 mixture, bounded to -500..500 counts. The candidate factor 0.002 maps the factory running range to -0.33..0.33. Every recording so far reads 0.
dashboard.label: A/F adjustment B2

dashboard.description: Smallest knock margin of evaluator channel 4 since the previous capture of its context: the knock threshold minus the knock metric, in evaluator counts without a physical unit. A positive value is headroom below the threshold, and a negative value is an evaluation that the ECU counts as knock. The channel number is the cylinder number of the event that opens the knock window.
dashboard.label: Knock margin ch 4

fields.name: knock_margin_min_ch4_raw
fields.scale: threshold minus metric in evaluator units, minimum since the previous capture of this context; 32767 without an evaluation or for a margin of 32767 or more

dashboard.description: Smallest knock margin of evaluator channel 5 since the previous capture of its context: the knock threshold minus the knock metric, in evaluator counts without a physical unit. A positive value is headroom below the threshold, and a negative value is an evaluation that the ECU counts as knock. The channel number is the cylinder number of the event that opens the knock window. The stock threshold row of this channel holds 0xFFFF, so it reads -- unless the metric exceeds 32768.
dashboard.label: Knock margin ch 5

fields.name: knock_margin_min_ch5_raw
fields.scale: threshold minus metric in evaluator units, minimum since the previous capture of this context; 32767 without an evaluation or for a margin of 32767 or more

dashboard.description: Smallest knock margin of evaluator channel 6 since the previous capture of its context: the knock threshold minus the knock metric, in evaluator counts without a physical unit. A positive value is headroom below the threshold, and a negative value is an evaluation that the ECU counts as knock. The channel number is the cylinder number of the event that opens the knock window.
dashboard.label: Knock margin ch 6

fields.name: knock_margin_min_ch6_raw
fields.scale: threshold minus metric in evaluator units, minimum since the previous capture of this context; 32767 without an evaluation or for a margin of 32767 or more

dashboard.description: A uint16 forward-conversion column coordinate formed from raw opening-area-domain counts divided by engine speed. Displayed in stored counts. Catalog QH0 Flow Potential at x*0.00152588 percent. The percentage remains candidate coordinate presentation and does not claim a measured physical flow or a bound source on an unresolved layout.
dashboard.label: Requested-torque column count

dashboard.description: Final ignition timing coordinate in degrees before TDC. A software command, not a measured spark angle. During a Rolling Launch late override it is the upstream stock coordinate, and APC command carries the effective value.
dashboard.label: Timing command

dashboard.description: Effective ignition timing command in degrees before TDC, as J1979 PID 0x0E reports it: 110 minus the APC byte. It follows Rolling Launch and the stock modes that move the command away from the timing coordinate. A software command, not a measured spark angle.
dashboard.label: APC command

dashboard.description: Cylinders whose injection the ECU cuts at this moment: none, all for a complete fuel cut, or the list of cut cylinders.
dashboard.label: Fuel inhibit mask

fields.name: fuel_inhibit_mask
fields.scale: bits: 0 CYLINDER_1, 1 CYLINDER_2, 2 CYLINDER_3, 3 CYLINDER_4, 4 CYLINDER_5, 5 CYLINDER_6

dashboard.description: Mass airflow sensor signal of bank 1 in volts, the ten-bit ADC count after a unit-nominal trim. The ECU converts it to airflow through its sensor table.
dashboard.label: MAF bank 1

dashboard.description: Mass airflow sensor signal of bank 2 in volts, the ten-bit ADC count after a unit-nominal trim. The ECU converts it to airflow through its sensor table.
dashboard.label: MAF bank 2

dashboard.description: Total intake airflow of both banks in g/s from the ECU airflow model, the value J1979 PID 0x10 reports. A model output, not a direct sensor reading.
dashboard.label: Total airflow

dashboard.description: Engine load that indexes the ignition and CVTC target maps: the Base Fuel Schedule as a ratio to the reference constant of the ROM in steps of 1/128, as the ECU computes it for the snapshot. 100 percent is the reference schedule, and the value saturates at 199.2 percent. The live value feed sends it as VQ Engine Load.
dashboard.label: Engine load

dashboard.description: Base Fuel Schedule: the base injection time in ms for the measured air charge, before the fuel trims, the target-mixture factor, and the injector opening time. Normalized to its reference constant, it is the load axis of the ignition and CVTC maps, which Engine load shows.
dashboard.label: Base fuel schedule

dashboard.description: Phase of the Rolling Launch runtime: IDLE while it evaluates the activation gates, ACTIVE while it owns the launch fuel cut and the optional ignition retard, and COOLDOWN after a run ends, until the buttons stay released for the rearm period.
dashboard.label: Rolling Launch phase

dashboard.description: Calculated injection pulse of channel 0, which drives cylinder 1 by the diagnostic Power Balance order: the compensated software command in ms at 10 us per count, not a measured injector-open time.
dashboard.label: Injection calc 0

dashboard.description: Calculated injection pulse of channel 1, which drives cylinder 2 by the diagnostic Power Balance order: the compensated software command in ms at 10 us per count, not a measured injector-open time.
dashboard.label: Injection calc 1

dashboard.description: Bank bits 0 and 1 of the composite learning gate written by FUN 00058740. Learning also requires the corresponding stability-permit bit. The physical meaning of every contributing condition is unreviewed.
dashboard.label: LTFT composite permit

dashboard.description: Bank bits 0 and 1 written by FUN 00058740 from bounded signal-change and derivative checks after the per-bank eligibility counters. Both permit bytes are required by the learned-grid update. Raw signal identities and physical learning permission remain unreviewed.
dashboard.label: LTFT stability permit

dashboard.description: Bit 0 participates in learned-grid reset and neutral LTFT publication. FUN 00057900 produces it as an edge pulse from request FFFF99D8.bit5 and latch FFFF4201.bit6. The exact diagnostic request and other control bits are unreviewed.
dashboard.label: LTFT neutralization state

dashboard.description: Raw 16-bit storage view of the generated Q8 transition state. The event timing stage consumes its unsigned high byte on the reviewed path; other modes use a separate latched path. Physical units and producer signedness remain unresolved, and the state is not exclusive to TCM requests.
dashboard.label: Generated torque transition state

dashboard.description: Scheduler snapshot of FFFF2466 before periodic tasks. Bit 6 permits the direct high-octane minus high-detonation map-difference branch when the prior coordinator state bit 7 is clear. Other bits and the physical producer of the switching state remain unreviewed.
dashboard.label: Knock input state

dashboard.description: Coordinator state captured after FUN 000493E8. Bit 7 inhibits the direct map-difference branch at the next evaluation. Use the previous contiguous snapshot to recover that input for the current pass. Other bits and their physical causes remain unreviewed.
dashboard.label: Knock branch state

dashboard.description: Signed timing state of the knock and high-detonation coordinator in 1/256 degree; its whole-number part enters the engine-event timing correction.
dashboard.label: Knock timing state

dashboard.description: Hot ignition surface in use: HIGH OCTANE or HIGH DETONATION. The knock coordinator selects it through several gates, one of them a hysteresis on a knock state, and the same bit scales the target mixture.
dashboard.label: Knock surface state

dashboard.description: Knock exceedances that the evaluator counted between two snapshots, saturating.
dashboard.label: Knock interval count

dashboard.description: Knock channels that had an exceedance between two snapshots.
dashboard.label: Knock channel mask

fields.name: knock_channel_mask_latched
fields.scale: six-position bit mask; bit c - 1 is knock channel c

dashboard.description: Accelerator pedal position sensor 1 in volts; it rises with pedal travel. Factory bands: 0.5..1.0 V released and 4.2..4.8 V fully depressed.
dashboard.label: APP 1

dashboard.description: Accelerator pedal position sensor 2 in volts, the second track that the ECU checks against sensor 1; it rises with pedal travel.
dashboard.label: APP 2

dashboard.description: Throttle position sensor 1 of the bank 1 electric throttle body in volts; it rises with opening. Factory criteria: above 0.36 V released and below 4.75 V fully depressed.
dashboard.label: TPS bank 1

dashboard.description: Absolute throttle position as J1979 PID 0x11 reports it, in percent of the byte range.
dashboard.label: Absolute throttle

dashboard.description: Throttle position sensor 1 of the bank 2 electric throttle body in volts; it rises with opening. Factory criteria: above 0.36 V released and below 4.75 V fully depressed.
dashboard.label: TPS bank 2

dashboard.description: Measured intake camshaft advance of bank 1 in crank degrees, from the phase of the cam sensor edges; a larger value is more advance.
dashboard.label: Intake CVTC actual B1

dashboard.description: Measured intake camshaft advance of bank 2 in crank degrees, from the phase of the cam sensor edges; a larger value is more advance.
dashboard.label: Intake CVTC actual B2

dashboard.description: Intake camshaft advance target common to both banks, in crank degrees. The CVTC controller drives the measured positions toward it.
dashboard.label: Intake CVTC target

dashboard.description: Exhaust camshaft target common to both banks, in crank degrees.
dashboard.label: Exhaust CVTC target

dashboard.description: Calculated load value of J1979 PID 0x04: the current airflow divided by the peak airflow. It is not the normalized Base Fuel Schedule that indexes the ignition and CVTC maps; Engine load carries that coordinate.
dashboard.label: Calculated load

dashboard.description: A final bounded signed internal request used as the inverse torque-surface input. Displayed in stored counts. Candidate requested torque at x*0.1 Nm, dependent on the unresolved physical conversion of the internal torque domain. Requested torque is not actual torque. The hardware actuator and bank boundaries remain explicit.
dashboard.label: Bounded request count

dashboard.description: A signed gross state in the ECU torque-model raw domain, before the recorded net-state deductions. Displayed in stored counts. Candidate x*0.1 Nm for the internal modeled state, with x*0.08 still compatible for the evaluated net torque chain. A candidate modeled-torque label is not measured flywheel torque. The gross and net terms remain distinct.
dashboard.label: Gross torque-model count

dashboard.description: Unsigned effective TCM reduction state after enable, shift, and inhibit handling. The enabled direct path uses the request byte shifted left by eight; other branches retain, limit, rebuild, decrease, or clear it. Raw stored counts without a physical torque conversion.
dashboard.label: Accepted TCM reduction state

dashboard.description: Measured exhaust camshaft position of bank 1 in crank degrees, from the phase of the cam sensor edges.
dashboard.label: Exhaust CVTC actual B1

dashboard.description: A shared unsigned area-domain target count used by the two channel-target conversions. Displayed in stored counts. Candidate physical target opening area at x*0.0008 cm2 for the shared throttle-body model. The count-domain role is established. The proposed geometric coefficient and physical aggregation remain unresolved rather than silently removed.
dashboard.label: Shared area-domain count

dashboard.description: Bank 1 throttle target as throttle opening above the learned closed position, on the percent scale the ECU publishes as J1979 absolute throttle. It is the coordinate of the throttle opening tables, and the live value feed publishes it for RomRaider Overlay Log.
dashboard.label: Throttle target channel 0

dashboard.description: Bank 2 throttle target as throttle opening above the learned closed position, on the percent scale the ECU publishes as J1979 absolute throttle.
dashboard.label: Throttle target channel 1

dashboard.description: Measured exhaust camshaft position of bank 2 in crank degrees, from the phase of the cam sensor edges.
dashboard.label: Exhaust CVTC actual B2
